objective.text: Build configuration cache in the intended release environment rather than shipping another environment's resolved values.

difficulty.rationale: Avoid carrying resolved configuration from one environment into another.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A build machine runs config:cache with staging values and ships bootstrap/cache/config.php unchanged to production. Production has different environment values. What deployment risk follows?

options.text: The cached file stores only configuration filenames and reevaluates every env call on load.
options.rationale: That is not how the resolved configuration cache works.
options.misconception: That is not how the resolved configuration cache works.

options.text: Only routing values are affected because config:cache excludes service credentials.
options.rationale: Configuration caching covers configuration data, not only route metadata.
options.misconception: Configuration caching covers configuration data, not only route metadata.

options.text: Production automatically ignores any cache file created on a different hostname.
options.rationale: The standard loader does not make that hostname-based provenance decision.
options.misconception: The standard loader does not make that hostname-based provenance decision.

options.text: The cached resolved staging configuration can be loaded in production; build that cache for the intended environment.
options.rationale: The cached file contains resolved configuration values, so changing runtime environment variables does not automatically recompute those cached entries.

explanation.summary: The cached file contains resolved configuration values, so changing runtime environment variables does not automatically recompute those cached entries.
